objective: Close an AI-coded deployment or workflow update.
what_changed: Marked the deployment update as done.
unresolved: Whether the deployed change can be safely rolled back: unknown.
Whether the production-facing effect was verified by an owner: unknown.
Whether the next coding agent knows what not to touch: unknown.
must_preserve: PASS is not a truth guarantee.
Production-facing closure must preserve evidence, rollback or restart point, and stop conditions.
DELAY and BLOCK remain valid integrity-preserving outputs.
reanchor_condition: Re-anchor if the deployment target, owner verification state, or rollback path changes.
next_self_should_not: Do not treat the deployment as complete without an evidence anchor.
Do not continue production-facing changes until a rollback or restart point is recorded.
Do not let the next coding agent infer missing stop conditions from the commit message.
notes: This is a developer-facing BLOCK example because a production-facing or irreversible closure lacks evidence, rollback or restart point, and stop conditions.
